# Kinetic energy calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/kinetic-energy/

Calculate classical kinetic energy, mass or speed from two known values. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Find the kinetic energy of a 2 kg object moving at 3 m/s.

## Limits and checks

This uses classical mechanics and SI units. Relativistic speeds, rotation and other energy stores are outside this model.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
